usages.explain: Expresses the idea that "the event happened as a result of a prolonged process and has now reached an extreme point". It is often a negative state.

examples.content: 社長はますます怒り、あげくの果てには部屋から全員部下を追い出した。。
examples.transcription: しゃちょうはますますおこり、あげくのはてにはへやからぜんいんぶかをおいだした。。
examples.mean: The president became even more angry and ended up kicking all his subordinates out of the room. .

examples.content: 彼は我慢に我慢を重ねたあげくの果てに、自分の観点を言い出した。
examples.transcription: かれはがまんにがまんをかさねたあげくのはてに、じぶんのかんてんをいいだした。
examples.mean: After much patience, he finally expressed his point of view.

title: あげくのはてに (は) => finally; in the end; on top of all that
